glyph.isekai_mahou.cataclysm.desc: Ultimate. Aim at a point up to 48 blocks away: a pillar of energy charges for 1.5 s, the ground shakes and then the spell's effects, at double power, devastate a HUGE area (radius 14) with shockwaves and blow a crater at the point of impact (if destruction is enabled). Programmable: On Hit springs from whoever was struck; On End, after the shockwaves.
glyph.isekai_mahou.domain_expansion.desc: Ultimate. Raises a dome around you for 12.5 s (radius 12 + 2.5 per Circle + 6 per Expand). Inside, the spell's effects strike enemies every second (without Sure Hit, only the ones you can see). Accepts Laws. BARRIER: it breaks from OUTSIDE, not from inside — those trapped cannot break it, but allies outside can (projectiles, explosions, spells and punches on the wall). With Invert right after this form, the barrier is INVERTED (+10% mana): it only breaks from inside and outsiders cannot get in. A larger domain of another owner can only attack your barrier from outside. When it ends (or breaks), causes Magic Exhaustion. Programmable: On End fires when the dome falls.
glyph.isekai_mahou.simple_domain.desc: Defense. A small dome (radius 3) that follows you for 5 s. Inside it, enemy domains' Sure Hit does not apply to you and your allies. Harmful effects strike anyone who enters; heals and shields apply to those inside.
glyph.isekai_mahou.law_sure_hit.desc: The domain's effects hit EVERY enemy inside, even hidden ones. Only a Simple Domain defends against it — and the barrier of a smaller domain of another owner protects whoever is inside it.
glyph.isekai_mahou.law_no_escape.desc: Enemies inside the dome are pushed back at the edge (and brought back if they teleport out). Projectiles hit the barrier.
glyph.isekai_mahou.law_territory.desc: Inside, you gain Strength and Resistance; enemies become Exposed and Weak.
glyph.isekai_mahou.law_nullify.desc: Enemies inside the dome are Silenced: their spells (including mobs') are nullified.
glyph.isekai_mahou.law_slow_time.desc: Enemies become very slow and their projectiles almost stop in mid-air.
glyph.isekai_mahou.law_gravity.desc: Enemies become heavy: they cannot jump, fall fast, and fliers are dragged to the ground.
glyph.isekai_mahou.law_landscape.desc: The ground inside the dome turns into the element (magma, ice, deepslate...) until the domain ends; then everything goes back to normal. Fusions — and spells with two elements that form a fusion — mix both.
glyph.isekai_mahou.law_open_barrier.desc: A domain without walls: 60% larger radius (75% with Absolute Domain), but it traps no one and has no barrier to break. Against a closed domain inside it, it attacks that barrier from outside on every pulse.
glyph.isekai_mahou.law_absolute.desc: Every law of the domain becomes stronger: faster pulses, stronger effects, a 25% tougher barrier that hurts whoever touches it, and Nullification drains mana.
glyph.isekai_mahou.law_ruin.desc: The domain devours the terrain inside: cracks run across the ground, the soil sinks and bursts in eruptions that hurl enemies away, fissures open under their feet — faster and faster. When the domain ends, a CRATER swallows the center. Respects the destruction rule (/mahou destruction) and cities.
message.isekai_mahou.domain_exhausted: The domain collapsed. You are magically exhausted.
message.isekai_mahou.domain_left: You left your domain and the barrier collapsed.
message.isekai_mahou.domain_nullified: Your spell was nullified by the domain!
message.isekai_mahou.domain_landscape_lo: This ground belongs to the domain. Wait for it to end.
message.isekai_mahou.domain_landscape_di: Elemental Landscape is disabled on this server (the ground does not change).
message.isekai_mahou.domain_ruin_disable: Terrain destruction is off: Ruin only shakes the ground.
message.isekai_mahou.domain_invert_no_ma: Not enough mana to invert the barrier (%s short): normal barrier.
